preconditions.description: The dimensions of the park are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i][j] <= n * m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All silence levels are within the range from 1 to n*m.

preconditions.expression: len(set(f[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(m))) == n * m
preconditions.description: All silence levels form a permutation of numbers from 1 to n*m.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for l in range(1, n * m + 1) for r in range(l, n * m + 1) if is_pleasant_segment(l, r))
postconditions.description: The output is the total number of pleasant segments of silence.
